roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Story, Chapters 1-2
roadmap.note: Play the story, do the Chapter 1 meditation before Chapter 1 ends, and start scanning with WAiNK whenever you pass something new.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Story, Chapters 3-4 and finale
roadmap.note: Finish the story. Every chapter and mission trophy here unlocks by playing through; keep a manual save before the big missions.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Stranger strands and side missions
roadmap.note: Clear the stranger mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, hunt the unique animal for Bret, and finish 8 strands.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Activities grind
roadmap.note: Shooting ranges, drone races, races, stunts, challenges, fishing, arcade and the 9 activity types. Most of this counts toward 100% too.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 — Crime, robberies and the open world
roadmap.note: Partner robberies, bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, gang operations, Combat Focus, and exploring all of Leonida.

roadmap.title: Stage 6 — Money, collectibles and cleanup
roadmap.note: Launder Marked Bills, spend in shops, buy every garage, register vehicles, finish the card sets and WAiNK scans, then the 100% checklist and the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Work the roadmap in order and treat this as the finish line, not a trophy to grind on its own.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order; the platinum unlocks automatically when the last one pops.
Finish the story first, since 13 trophies are tied to chapters and missions.
Clear the side strands and activities next, while the story is still fresh.
Use the 100% completion checklist in the Progress menu to find what is left.
Do the missable Chapter 1 meditation early so it never blocks the run.
Check the tracker here after each session and tick trophies off as they pop.

claims.text: Vice Got a Price! is the platinum trophy of GTA 6.
It unlocks by earning every other trophy in the base game.
The full list is 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
On Xbox the same achievement is worth 0 Gamerscore.
No online trophy is needed for the platinum.
The 100% completion gold is part of the platinum path.
Guides put the platinum at roughly 200 hours.
The list went public when the game unlocked on 18 Nov 2026.
PSN lists the set at 1,350 points in total.

dispute.a: PSNProfiles and TrueTrophies list the set at 1,350 PSN points.
dispute.b: Adding the grades up (46 bronze at 15, 6 silver at 30, 2 gold at 90, platinum at 180) gives 1,230 points.
dispute.call: Our call: show 1,350 as the published total and do not re-derive it; the per-grade values are the standard PSN scale, the published total is what the trackers list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 spots. The Chapter 1 balcony session at Jason's house is missable: do it the morning after Down to Earth, when Lucia invites you. The other 8 spots give 2 meditations each, one per character, and the Ascent session at Mount Kalaga only appears after the rest are done.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia at Jason's house and accept the meditation invite on the balcony.
Meditate at Smooth Sand, the sandbar west of Capri, with both characters.
Meditate at the Swamp dock in Buckskin Swamp with both characters.
Meditate at Worn Stone on the Emerald River at Camp Moonflower with both characters.
Meditate at Red Rocks in Manifest Canyon, the Water Wheel in south Moreau, Jutting Cliff, the Waterfall and Seaside, each with both characters.
When the Ascent session is marked on the map at the Mount Kalaga summit, meditate there for the 18th.
